title: One Run's work in the shared store, pinned to one Worker or open to any that may take it. The Orchestrator writes the request and any cancel; the Worker claims it under a lease and writes the report.

id.description: The Run's id: one order per Run.

worker.description: The Worker it is pinned to. Absent on an open order.

open.description: Who may take an open order: any Worker that has the request's program, offers every word in `requires`, and is a cloud Worker or not as `cloud` says.

cancel.description: A cancel asked for by an Orchestrator; the first ask stands.

claim.description: The Worker's hold on the order, taken by a conditional write and kept by renewing it before `until`; once `until` has passed, a portable handle may be taken over by another Worker and a local one ends the order lost.

at.description: When this Worker took the order.

until.description: Until when the claim holds unless renewed.

handle.description: The Performer's handle, once the work has started.

portable.description: Whether the handle means anything on another machine (a cloud job's id does).

report.description: The claiming Worker's latest word: progress while it runs, the outcome once it ends (final). An order nobody took may be ended canceled, and one whose local claim lapsed ended lost, by an Orchestrator. The log is kept beside the order, appended as it grows, and is not part of this document.

time.description: RFC 3339, UTC, so that later sorts later.

class.description: The failure's class, the Performer's word; `refused`, `fault` and `lost` are the engine's.

run.description: The Run's id. A Performer asked twice for the same Run starts one program.

definition.description: The verb: a program may perform several and picks by name.

program.description: The program the StepDefinition names; a Worker runs the command it registered under that name.

needs.description: What the work needs, to size it by: the StepDefinition's needs, with what the deployment computes for this request over them (docs/PLACEMENT.md §7).

inputs.description: Every Input that holds a Value, by name. Values are opaque JSON.

parameters.description: Every Parameter in effect (the verb's default where no Actor chose), by name.

outputs.description: What a success must produce: each declared Output, by name and tag.

options.description: Present on a Decision (tag `decision`): the words its Value may be.

name.description: No dots: names are joined with ports by a dot.

tag.description: An opaque label, compared for equality.
